def main():
    s = input().strip()
    ans = 0
    
    groups = split_into_groups(s)
    for group in groups:
        if len(group) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

def split_into_groups(s):
    groups = []
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        groups.append(s[i:j])
        i = j
    return groups

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
